notes: The bet and its suffix in the first clause are separately unrepresented: whatsoever fuses kol and asher only, and carries no locative sense for the preposition to share (rules 22, 30, 40).
The it after the second toucheth is added, no object morpheme standing in that clause (rule 44).
The article on the second participle takes the relative that under rule 41, the noun's own article keeping the written the.
